sections.bio:
Founder of JK Solutions Consultancy, a recruitment and talent acquisition firm dedicated to helping organizations build high-performing teams through end-to-end hiring solutions.

With expertise in recruitment, talent sourcing, candidate assessment, stakeholder management, and onboarding, I work closely with startups, product companies, IT services firms, and enterprises to identify and attract top talent. Our focus is on delivering quality hires, reducing time-to-fill, and creating a seamless hiring experience for both clients and candidates.

At JK Solutions Consultancy, we support organizations across IT and Non-IT domains, offering customized recruitment solutions tailored to business needs. We believe that great people are the foundation of every successful organization, and our mission is to connect exceptional talent with meaningful career opportunities.

I am always open to connecting with business leaders, hiring managers, HR professionals, recruitment partners, and talented professionals seeking new opportunities.

AI can understand a lot of languages. But understanding a language and understanding how people actually speak it are two different things. 
 
That's the kind of work **Aether** is looking for native speakers to help with. 
 
They're currently seeking people who speak **Korean, German, Bangla, Chinese, Italian, Spanish, Hindi, or French** for audio-based AI tasks. 
 
The work is pretty straightforward: 
 
* Listen to and work with audio in your native language 
* Help AI better understand real pronunciation and natural speech 
* Read and write English well enough to follow the task instructions 
* Complete the work using your own computer and working audio 
 
You don't need professional recording equipment or a studio setup. A computer with working audio is enough. 
 
If one of these is your native language, this could be a great opportunity to put your language skills to work on AI projects. 
 
🔗 Apply using the link below: 
 https://lnkd.in/dw2g4vWA
🟢 Having trouble applying? DM me. 
 
If you speak one of these languages, have you ever noticed AI misunderstanding your accent, pronunciation, or words? Share your experience in the comments.
